_comment: Hand-authored mapping of each M3 glossary term to the OpenUI vocabulary. {{Name}} is resolved to a link by tools/build_reports.py. match is one of: Exact, Alias, Narrower, Broader, Related, Homonym, Gap, Out of scope.

Adaptive design.alias: {{Responsive Reflow}}, {{Breakpoint}} (Layout, folder abstraction). M3's term is broader: it also covers component adaptations driven by user, device or environment conditions. OpenUI has no 'adaptive' term.

App bar.alias: {{Toolbar}} (Tool bars): a bar of commands. {{Bar}} (A50) is the shared shape. OpenUI names a bar by purpose and not by position, so the top placement is not part of the term. {{Shell bar}} (A67) is the application-shell analogue.

Banner.alias: {{Alert}} (Feedback widgets, `role=alert`): a prominent message with optional actions. Not {{Hero banner}} (A74), which is a greeting surface, and not the ARIA `banner` landmark (a page header; see {{Scaffold}}).

Chip.alias: No single term. A set of chips is a {{Token collection}} or {{Editable chip collection}} (List, A20 and A21). One filter chip is a {{Toggle button}}, an assist chip a {{Button}}, a status chip a {{Tag}}. Candidate new alias: Chip.

Color: Baseline scheme.alias: {{Color}} and {{Theme}} (Presentation, folder abstraction). No term for a named default scheme.

Color: Dynamic color.alias: {{Color}} and {{Theme}} (Presentation). No term for a scheme derived at run time from user input.

Color: Extended color.alias: {{Color}} (Presentation). No term for brand or semantic colors added beyond the key colors.

Color: Key color.alias: {{Color}} (Presentation). M3 itself says key colors are a concept for understanding, not used in code.

Color: Scheme.alias: {{Color}}; {{Theme}} (Presentation). M3 separates a scheme (a mapping of color roles to tones) from a theme (several styles together). OpenUI has only Theme.

Color: Source color.alias: {{Color}} (Presentation). No term for the one color a scheme is derived from.

Color: Tonal palette.alias: {{Color}} (Presentation). No term for a ramp of tones of one hue.

Color: Tone.alias: {{Color}} (Presentation). No term for lightness as a color axis.

Color: User-generated schemes.alias: {{Color}} and {{Theme}} (Presentation). Host-supplied (wallpaper or preset) color input is not in the tree.

Condition.alias: {{Breakpoint}} and {{Responsive Reflow}} (Layout) are the closest. Not {{Trigger}} (glossary), which starts a behavior and does not select a layout.

Contrast.alias: {{Color}} (Presentation). Contrast is an accessibility measure that no OpenUI term names.

Customization.alias: {{Theme}} for global customization; {{Attribute}} (glossary) for per-element configuration.

Dark theme.alias: {{Theme}} (Presentation). A dark theme is one theme; OpenUI does not name theme variants.

Data table.alias: {{Table}} (glossary: 'data table' is an alias). When the table is interactive, {{Data grid}}.

Design attribute.alias: The Presentation notions ({{Color}}, {{Typography}}, {{Shape}}) are the design attributes a style sets. Not {{Attribute}} (glossary), which is a key under an element's `attrs`.

Design specs.alias: Documentation, not UI vocabulary. The nearest OpenUI artifact is a scope file, which is an object contract.

Design System Package (DSP).alias: An Adobe file format for sharing design systems between tools; not UI vocabulary.

Design tokens.alias: {{Spacing tokens}} (Presentation) is the only token term. The Presentation scope speaks of technology-independent visual tokens but leaves the token format out. Candidate new term: Design token.

Design tokens: Context.alias: {{Theme}} and {{Visual states}} (Presentation) cover some contexts, such as dark theme. No term for the set of conditions as such.

Design tokens: Role.alias: No OpenUI term. Not the ARIA `role` (the HTML / WAI-ARIA column of the taxonomy mapping).

Design tokens: Types.alias: No OpenUI term for the reference, system and component token tiers.

Dialog.alias: {{Dialog}} (glossary; Widgets/dialog). Its modal behavior is {{Modal overlay}}.

Element.alias: Same name, different meaning. M3: a part of a component that a token applies to (container, label text). OpenUI {{Element}} (glossary): one node of a document tree. OpenUI has no term for a part of a component.

Extended FAB.alias: {{Button}} (glossary lists 'floating action button' and 'FAB' as aliases; a variant, not a separate primitive).

HCT.alias: {{Color}} (Presentation). A color-space name; no OpenUI term.

Image list.alias: {{List}} of {{Image}} items, or a {{Grid}}. {{Icon collection}} (A30) is the closest list alias.

Libraries.alias: Implementation and platform support, not UI vocabulary.

Material Components.alias: A framework product. Framework names are not OpenUI terms ({{Naming rule}}).

Material Design.alias: The design system itself; OpenUI treats it as an external framework example.

Material Theming.alias: {{Theme}} (Presentation): the ability to customize styles systematically.

Mode.alias: A system or host setting (focus mode, airplane mode). OpenUI uses 'mode' only in {{Selection mode}} and {{Progress mode}}. Host integration is out of v1 (plan question Q9).

Navigation rail.alias: {{Navigation Rail}} (Navigation widgets); {{Rail}} is the structural container.

Progress indicator.alias: {{Progress bar}} (linear) and {{Spinner}} or {{Loader}} (circular), with {{Progress mode}} for determinate or indeterminate (Status indicator).

Orbiter.alias: No XR vocabulary in OpenUI. {{Toolbar}} and {{Popover}} are the nearest floating controls.

Radio button.alias: {{Radio button}} (Choice controls); a group is {{Exclusive selection coordination}}.

Role.alias: A design-token slot. No OpenUI term; not the ARIA `role`.

Slider.alias: {{Slider}} (Range control); two handles are the {{Range slider}}.

Style.alias: {{Presentation}} (scope): visual styling notions such as color, typography and shape.

Toolbar.alias: {{Toolbar}} (Tool bars), a bar of commands, with {{Bar}} (A50). M3 places its Toolbar at the bottom of mobile screens; OpenUI's term does not depend on placement.
